title: Flood & Waterlogging Emergency Protocols
emergencyWarning: 🚨 IMMEDIATE DANGER: Turn off main power if water rises near electrical outlets. Never walk or drive through moving floodwaters. For urgent rescue in India, call National Emergency 112.
immediateActions: Move immediately to higher ground or upper floors of a sturdy concrete building.
Keep emergency flashlight, battery-powered radio, clean water, and essential medicines ready.
Listen to official SACHET / CWC flood alerts on radio or phone.
Disconnect main electrical switches and LPG gas valves if safe to do so.
actionsToAvoid: Do NOT walk, swim, or drive through moving floodwaters—6 inches of moving water can knock you down.
Do NOT touch electrical wires, power poles, or submerged electrical equipment.
Do NOT drink unboiled or flood-contaminated water.
evacuationAndShelter: If advised by local disaster authorities to evacuate, leave immediately following designated safe routes.
Move calmly to designated Stadium or School Relief Shelters.
Help elderly persons, children, and persons with disabilities evacuate safely.
afterEventPrecautions: Return home only when local government authorities declare it safe.
Inspect home for structural cracks, gas leaks, and damaged electrical wiring before entering.
Disinfect all flooded surfaces and drink boiled or bottled water only.

title: Fire & Smoke Evacuation Protocols
emergencyWarning: 🚨 IMMEDIATE DANGER: Toxic smoke kills faster than flames. Get low, stay below smoke, and evacuate immediately. Call Fire Control Room 101 or Emergency 112.
immediateActions: Alert everyone in the building immediately by shouting or triggering the fire alarm.
Evacuate the building immediately using stairs.
Crawl low under smoke where air is cleaner and cooler.
Feel doors with the back of your hand before opening—if hot, do NOT open.
actionsToAvoid: Do NOT use elevators/lifts during a fire emergency.
Do NOT open hot doors or doors where smoke is billowing underneath.
Do NOT re-enter a burning building for personal belongings under any circumstances.
evacuationAndShelter: Proceed calmly to the pre-designated assembly point outside the building.
If trapped inside a room: Close doors, seal cracks with wet cloth, and signal for help at a window.
Call 101 or 112 and provide your exact room number and location.
afterEventPrecautions: Seek immediate medical attention for smoke inhalation or burns, even if minor.
Do not re-enter damaged buildings until fire safety officers grant permission.
Contact insurance and local emergency relief authorities for rehabilitation support.

title: Earthquake Tremor & Structural Safety Protocols
emergencyWarning: 🚨 IMMEDIATE DANGER: DROP, COVER, and HOLD ON during tremors. Stay away from glass, windows, and unanchored walls. Call 112 if trapped.
immediateActions: DROP to your hands and knees immediately.
COVER your head and neck under a sturdy table, desk, or interior furniture.
HOLD ON to your shelter until shaking completely stops.
If in bed: Stay in bed, cover your head with a pillow, and protect your face.
actionsToAvoid: Do NOT run outside while shaking is occurring—falling debris causes most injuries.
Do NOT stand under doorways, near window glass, or heavy overhead light fixtures.
Do NOT use elevators during or immediately after tremors.
evacuationAndShelter: Once shaking stops, evacuate calmly using staircase to open ground away from buildings, trees, and power lines.
If outdoors: Move to an open field or park away from tall buildings, utility poles, and streetlights.
Expect aftershocks and remain in open areas.
afterEventPrecautions: Check yourself and nearby people for injuries; administer basic first aid.
Inspect utility lines (gas, water, electricity) for leaks or sparks.
Do not enter structurally damaged buildings after severe tremors.

title: Thunderstorm, Cyclone & Lightning Protocols
emergencyWarning: 🚨 IMMEDIATE DANGER: When thunder roars, go indoors! Lightning can strike up to 10 miles away from rain. Call 112 for storm casualties.
immediateActions: Seek shelter inside a sturdy concrete building or hard-topped metal vehicle immediately.
Unplug sensitive electrical appliances and stay away from corded phones.
Stay away from windows, glass doors, and outer walls during high wind gusts.
Keep phone charged and monitor official IMD weather advisories.
actionsToAvoid: Do NOT stand under tall trees, metal structures, tin sheds, or open poles during lightning.
Do NOT take shelter near water bodies, metal fences, or high ground during storms.
Do NOT venture out to inspect cyclone or wind damage until official all-clear is given.
evacuationAndShelter: For cyclones: Evacuate coastal low-lying areas to designated cyclone shelters as advised by SDMA.
Secure windows, doors, and loose outdoor items before high winds hit.
Stay in interior rooms away from windows during storm peak.
afterEventPrecautions: Watch out for fallen trees, live electric wires, and damaged roads.
Avoid standing near unstable walls, roofs, or loose signboards.
Report snapped electric cables to the electricity board or local emergency control room.
